# 📚 Library Management System (React)

A minimalist **Library Management System UI** built using **React** and **Tailwind CSS**.
The project simulates core DBMS concepts such as book issuing, returning, stock management, issue tracking, and fine calculation using frontend state management.

---

## 🚀 Features

* 📘 View available books
* 👥 Manage members
* 📖 Issue books
* 🔄 Return books
* 📜 Live issue transaction registry
* 📦 Automatic stock updates
* 🚫 Prevent issuing out-of-stock books
* 🔢 Auto-generated issue numbers (sequence simulation)
* 💰 Fine calculation system
* 📊 Total issued counter for each book
* 🔍 Book search functionality
* 🎨 Responsive modern UI using Tailwind CSS

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

* React
* JavaScript
* Tailwind CSS
* Vite

## ⚙️ Installation

Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/your-username/library-management-system-react.git
```

Navigate to the project directory:

```bash
cd library-management-system-react
```

Install dependencies:

```bash
npm install
```

Start the development server:

```bash
npm run dev
```

---

## 📸 Features Demonstrated

### Issue Book

* Validates member and book
* Checks stock availability
* Generates automatic issue number
* Updates stock and issue registry

### Return Book

* Restores stock
* Calculates fines
* Updates return status

---

## 🧠 DBMS Concepts Simulated

This frontend project mimics several backend database concepts:

* Tables using React state
* Triggers using JavaScript functions
* Sequences using auto-increment state
* Constraints and validations
* Transaction management
